cases.q: What has he done for accessibility?
cases.answer: Craig has worked with accessible UI since building UI libraries held to WCAG for clients. He ensures his own site is held to WCAG 2.2 AA standards, using an automated suite that checks the site after every deploy and every week to prevent regressions. This suite includes axe-core checks for every page state, keyboard navigation, focus visibility, and reflow/spacing. He also implements design tokens to ensure text contrast meets a 4.5:1 ratio and includes controls for reduced-motion users and the ability to switch off single-key shortcuts to avoid clashing with screen readers. See accessibility.md.

Yes, Craig remains a skilled, hands-on engineer. While he sets strategy and leads teams, he has upskilled in AI-assisted development and maintains recent upstream pull requests on his site.
